To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
two variants of BK channel, inactivating and non- inactivating, exist in rat adrenal chromaf fin cells.

in rat chromaffin cell, two types of Ca(2+) and voltage dependent BK channels, inactivating and non-inactivating, are expressed in a cell-to-cell variation and the functional role of these two types of BK channels in chromaffin cell excitability is different.
in rat chromaffin cell culture, two types of large-conducting Ca(2+ and voltage-dependent K(+) channels (BK) are expressed, one of which inactivates and the other does not.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of BK channels in the generation and regulation of electrical activity in chromaffin cells of the rat adrenal gland and other cells in the nervous system.
the role of Ca2+ and K+ channels in the generation and regulation of action potentials in rat adrenal chromafin cells.
the role of BK channels in defining the electrical properties of chromaffine cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are two variants of BK channels in rat adrenal chromafi cells, one non-inactivating and one rapidly inactivating.
inactivating BK currents are important for action potential repolarisation and the ability to fire repetitivly.
the inactivation of the BK channel, in addition to its activation by voltage and Ca2+, plays a role in the regulation of the membrane potential of adrenal chromaffin cell.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the properties of Ca(+)2- and voltage-dependent K(+) currents in rat chromaffin cell are not only determined by the properties of the underlying channel, but also by the type of channel expressed in the cell.
the BK channel in rat chromaffin cell is not homogeneous but rather is heterogeneous.
there are two distinct types of BK channels that are expressed differentially in chromaffin cells, and that these channels play distinct roles in the physiology of the chromaffin cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the BK channel is highly heterogeneous, and the properties of the BK channel are cell-type dependent.
there are two different types of BK channels, one of which inactivates.
there are two types of BK channels in rat chromaffin cell membranes, one inactivating and the other non-inactivating.
